## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: A new user- or agent-facing feature
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates only
- [ ] `style`: Formatting or whitespace changes without logic alterations
- [ ] `refactor`: Code reorganization with identical runtime behavior
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvements
- [ ] `test`: Test suite additions or corrections
- [ ] `ci`: CI/CD workflows and automated pipelines
- [ ] `chore`: Repository housekeeping, dependencies, or hygiene

## Checklist

- [ ] All commit messages adhere to **Conventional Commits 1.0.0** (`fluidise-clint` compliant).
- [ ] No `Co-authored-by:` or trailing bot attribution lines in commit messages.
- [ ] Invariant preserved: **Zero Runtime Dependencies** (no arbitrary Node/Python runtime requirements added).
- [ ] Invariant preserved: **Deterministic & Agent-First** interfaces (stable exit codes and schemas).
- [ ] Documentation and internal/external links have been verified.
